# Application Domain - Micro-Frontend Architecture Patterns

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Patterns](../../README.md) • [Application](../README.md)**

This directory contains application-level patterns for micro-frontend architecture within the **Application Domain**. These patterns focus on building modular, independently deployable frontend applications that enable incremental modernization and scalable user interfaces.
page_texts.2:
[patterns/application/micro-frontend/README.md#overview]

## Overview

Micro-Frontend Architecture patterns address:

- **Module Boundaries**: Defining independent, deployable frontend modules
- **Module Composition**: Runtime composition using Webpack Module Federation
- **Integration**: Communication patterns between frontend modules
- **Migration**: Modernizing legacy ASP.NET applications to React
- **Governance**: Architecture standards and quality gates

## Pattern Maturity

These patterns capture proven practices for building micro-frontend applications at enterprise scale. They reflect Gainwell Health's experience migrating legacy ASP.NET applications to modern React-based architectures while maintaining HIPAA compliance and Section 508 accessibility standards.
